newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down after two-day gains.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down after two-day gains.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall on Friday after two days of gains, signalled by stronger selling after price fixing and at continuous trade on Thursday.

Analysts said wide-spread expectations of an official interest rate rise, which could occur at any moment, may also weigh down stocks, which were already moving in a gradual downtrend ahead of paliamentary polls in September.
Analysts expected the central bank, whose decision making board meets later on Friday, to up nominal rates between one and two percent from the present 22 and 25 percent.
